東涌綫延綫隧道 - 鑽挖篇 Tung Chung Line Extension - Tunnel Boring Works

【鐵路鑽深啲👷 東涌綫延綫隧道鑽挖篇 #4 】隧道鑽挖機女神「羲和」已經順利完成鑽挖東涌站至東涌西站嘅上行綫隧道喇👏佢今年初由東涌站出發，穿過高山越過大海，一路挖掘、一路鋪好隧道壁，最後成功抵達位於東涌西站嘅豎井，完成佢嘅首躺旅程！ 小編好開心有份親眼見證佢「破牆而出」嘅一刻😍之後「羲和」就會喺豎井掉頭，向返東涌站方向完成埋下行綫隊道鑽挖工程喇～ 📹一齊感受吓「羲和」貫通嘅「震撼」畫面啦！ #羲和 #隧道貫通 #東涌綫延綫 #東涌西站 #新鐵路建設無限未來 [Railway 101👷 – Tung Chung Line Extension’s Tunnel Boring Works #4 ] Earlier this year, Tunnel Boring Machine “Xihe” set off from Tung Chung Station and diligently worked underground — digging through hard rock layers and subsea mixed soil. After overcoming tough geological challenges, it successfully broke through the up-track tunnel to the future Tung Chung West Station, marking a major milestone for the Tung Chung Line Extension! 👏This breakthrough isn’t just a big step in construction — it’s a vital move toward connecting communities and building the future. 🎯 “Xihe” is now being prepared in the U-turn shaft at the Tung Chung West Station worksite, getting ready to start excavating the down-track tunnel toward Tung Chung Station.📹 Let’s feel the power of the epic breakthrough moment via the video! #Xihe #TunnelBreakthrough #TungChungLineExtension #TungChungWestStation #NewRailwaysGoBeyondBoundaries
